deploy.startCommand: echo MARKER_BEGIN_TENANT && date -u && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy 2>&1; echo "MARKER_TENANT_EXIT=$?" && date -u && echo MARKER_BEGIN_PLATFORM && ./node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy --schema=prisma/platform/schema.prisma 2>&1; echo "MARKER_PLATFORM_EXIT=$?" && date -u && echo MARKER_STARTING_APP && node dist/main
